kept_candidate.requirement: A Data Fiduciary must cease processing personal data of a Data Principal who has withdrawn consent, unless processing is required or authorized by law.
kept_candidate.checkable_test: Verify if the document states that processing must cease upon withdrawal of consent, unless required by law.
kept_candidate.applicability: Applies to all Data Fiduciaries handling personal data of Data Principals.
kept_candidate.notes: This obligation is directly tied to the withdrawal of consent and cessation of processing.
